name: Project Assistant — Echo (dev-only)
description: Zero-LLM flow that echoes the user's latest message back as the assistant reply. Use for: CI smoke tests, UI development without burning LLM tokens, verifying SSE/guard/session wiring end-to-end when external providers are rate-limited or down, and customer demos where cost-per-interaction must be zero. Not for production — the model isn't answering anything.

edges.description: User message goes straight to the echo transform — no safety classification, no retrieval, no LLM.
